DRAG DROP -
Drag and drop the streaming telemetry concepts from the left onto the correct definitions on the right.
bank: Google Protocol Buffers and JSON format
remote management system or application that stores the telemetry data
collected from the Data Management Engine database using a distinguished name paths
theory: Nexus streaming telemetry breaks into four functional pieces: data collection pulls values from the Data Management Engine database using object distinguished-name paths; data encoding formats that raw data into a structured format such as Google Protocol Buffers or JSON; data transport moves the encoded data over the wire using UDP or secure UDP (DTLS); and the telemetry receiver is simply the remote management system or application that ultimately stores and consumes the exported data. Mapping each mechanism to its stage clarifies that how data is gathered, packaged, transported, and consumed are four separate, independently configurable parts of the pipeline. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — Streaming Telemetry Building Blocks)
